title: Minimally rational reallocation of objects
abstract: arXiv:2609.28174v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Matching theory has largely evolved around two canonical rules: deferred acceptance (DA) in the marriage problem and top trading cycles (TTC) in the object reallocation problem. Although the two rules operate through different procedures, we show that they rest on a common axiomatic foundation. In the marriage problem, stability decomposes into individual rationality and pair rationality, and a classic result characterizes DA by these two axioms together with strategy-proofness for the proposing side. We show that individual rationality, pair rationality, and strategy-proofness likewise characterize TTC. More strongly, three weak rationality axioms concerning individuals and pairs, together with strategy-proofness, uniquely determine TTC. Even weak rationality requirements therefore rule out strategy-proof implementation when there is a cap on the size of exchange cycles.

translated_title: 物品重新配置的最小理性要求
translated_abstract: 匹配理论主要围绕两个经典规则发展：婚姻问题中的延迟接受算法（DA）与物品重新配置问题中的最优交易循环机制（TTC）。尽管这两种规则通过不同的程序运作，我们证明它们建立在共同的公理化基础之上。在婚姻问题中，稳定性可分解为个体理性与配对理性，一个经典结果表明DA可由这两个公理加上提议方的策略防操纵性来刻画。我们证明，个体理性、配对理性与策略防操纵性同样刻画了TTC。更进一步，仅需三个关于个体和配对的弱理性公理，加上策略防操纵性，即可唯一地确定TTC。因此，即便是很弱的理性要求，在交换循环规模存在上限的情况下，也会排除策略防操纵的实现。
tldr: 本文证明物品重新配置中的TTC机制与婚姻问题中的DA机制共享相同的公理化基础——个体理性、配对理性与策略防操纵性即可唯一刻画TTC，且当交换循环规模受限时，即使弱理性要求也会排除策略防操纵机制的存在。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that TTC in object reallocation rests on the same axiomatic foundation as DA in the marriage problem—individual rationality, pair rationality, and strategy-proofness uniquely characterize TTC, and even weak rationality requirements rule out strategy-proof implementation when exchange cycle sizes are capped.
